Container.Name: jaeger
Container.Overview:
Jaeger v2, an open source, end-to-end distributed tracing platform based on OpenTelemetry Collector.
This all-in-one configuration combines the collector, query, and UI components in a single process, using transient in-memory storage for trace data.
https://www.jaegertracing.io/
Container.Description: Jaeger v2 all-in-one: collector, query service, and web UI running as a single process based on the OpenTelemetry Collector. Accepts traces via OTLP (gRPC/HTTP) or the Zipkin-compatible endpoint and stores them in transient in-memory storage, so traces do not persist across container restarts. Ideal for local development, testing OpenTelemetry instrumentation, or short-lived tracing sessions.

Config.Name: Container Port 1
Config.Description: Jaeger UI and query API for viewing traces.

Config.Name: Container Port 2
Config.Description: OTLP gRPC receiver for ingesting trace data from OpenTelemetry SDKs.

Config.Name: Container Port 3
Config.Description: OTLP HTTP receiver for ingesting trace data (Protobuf or JSON) from OpenTelemetry SDKs.

Config.Name: Container Port 4
Config.Description: Serves remote sampling configuration to Jaeger clients.

Config.Name: Container Port 5
Config.Description: Zipkin-compatible endpoint for accepting spans in Zipkin v1/v2 format.
